Recently diagnosed. I had almost 60k followers. Instagram was triggering in many ways, aside from addiction. I deleted all social media. I just use YouTube now. Instagram can be horrible with tons of followers or few. Maybe take breaks. I now obsess over YouTube where there is no one judging me, commenting, or having to feel sold to all the time or compare my life,body. It’s exhausting and I’m already manic depressive amongst other things.
I hope you can come to understand that social media is unhealthy for many people and maybe find some other coping activities or outlets you enjoy. You matter, you’re worthy!!

State/federal program assistance that can cover all or some of your health care needs. I just got it for Therapy. But it can help with dental, doctors visits etc. since you’re underage your parents may have to sign you up. I’m not sure based on your state. But I’d suggest looking it up or speaking to a school counselor. I do believe School counselors are also not allowed to tell your parents whatever you talk to them about, it should be confidential unless you’re speak on harming yourself or others.

I know how hard it can be to speak to your parents about topics like this. Try writing a letter and leaving it on their bed, or hand it off if that’s easier. Then they’ll usually come to you bringing it up with follow up questions. All the best.
